name: What preparation do I need to do before bathtub installation?

mainEntity.name: What preparation do I need to do before bathtub installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installation, clear the bathroom of all personal items, towels, and decorations. Ensure clear access for installers to move the new tub and remove the old one. If you're doing any demolition yourself, coordinate with our team regarding the timeline. It's also helpful to have your chosen fixtures and accessories on hand, although we can also source them for you. Discuss any specific concerns or requests with our team prior to the scheduled installation date.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the bathroom, ensure clear access for installers, and have any new fixtures ready. Coordinate with our team on demolition and specific requests.
